meta.name: Lamp Sample Quiz
meta.description: Questions for the Lamp Sample Plan, graded for two age groups.

questions.question: What did God make on the first day?
questions.answer: Light. God said, Let there be light, and there was light.

questions.question: What does the choice of the verb "created" in verse 1 signal about the subject of the sentence?
questions.answer: The Hebrew verb bara is used only with God as its subject, so the grammar itself marks the act as uniquely divine.

questions.question: Who is the Word that John writes about?
questions.answer: Jesus. John says the Word was with God, was God, and became flesh.

questions.question: Why does John open with "In the beginning"?
questions.answer: It echoes Genesis 1:1, framing the incarnation as an act of creation rather than merely the start of a life.
